brief:
Spain's High Court granted conditional bail to James "Fergie" Chambers, a pro-Palestinian philanthropist, Al Jazeera English reported. Chambers had been detained in connection with unspecified charges. The court imposed conditions on his release, though details of those restrictions were not disclosed.

Chambers is known for his philanthropic work supporting Palestinian causes. His detention and subsequent bail hearing drew attention from activism circles focused on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.
dek: Spain’s High Court granted conditional bail to James ‘Fergie’ Chambers, a pro-Palestinian philanthropist.
title: Spanish court grants bail to pro-Palestinian activist Chambers
